content.text: A first-run checklist on the dashboard, sliced into five sub-tasks.

scope: onboarding
scenario: F1 = Given a new member with no team, When they open the dashboard, Then they see sample projects and "Invite your team" in the checklist
scenario: F2 = Given a member with two unfinished set-up steps, When they open the dashboard, Then only one set-up step is shown
scenario: F3 = Given a member whose profile is partial, When they open the dashboard, Then the checklist asks them to finish the profile
scenario: F4 = Given a member with nothing left to set up, When they open the dashboard, Then the page shows real content and never an empty page
scenario: F5 = Given a member who has finished set-up and never booked a demo, When they open the dashboard, Then the demo is the one suggestion, and it stops once one is booked
